candidates.title: Eval bug: LFM2.5-24B-A2B emits Qwen3-Coder-style <tool_call> XML as content — calls silently lost (lfm2moe)
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  With LiquidAI's **LFM2.5-24B-A2B** (`arch = lfm2moe`), the model intermittently emits tool calls in the **Qwen3-Coder-style XML** shape as *plain text*. `llama-server` returns `finish_reason: "stop"` with empty `tool_calls` and the block in `content`, so the call is **silently lost** (clients show raw XML in the transcript). The LFM2.5 parser only accepts the vendor's control-token form, so this shape cannot be recovered.  Emitted (content, verbatim):  ``` <tool_call> <function=edit>
